algorithms.name: clip source admission and rule mapping
algorithms.proof: Clip planner: exact child/reference/job byte caps, wrapper worst-prefix budget, direct-child count, depth, ancestor CssPaint inheritance, stylesheet rules and source offsets.

algorithms.name: clip containment and boundary traversal
algorithms.proof: Winding/even-odd point query; object-box normalization; ordered chain intersection; stable boundary mapping/early-stop; checked chain/child/edge accounting.

algorithms.name: clip ownership and mutation
algorithms.proof: Scene ClipId sharing, deduplicated bounded overlays, capacity accounting, valid owner update, actual DraftToken finalizers, ordered safe chain copy.

algorithms.name: filter primitives and named results
algorithms.proof: All supported primitive types, input defaults/results, merge bounds, matrix defaults/values, exact named unsupported kinds, flood-color alpha rounding and count/region limits.

algorithms.name: marker placement and inheritance
algorithms.proof: Ancestor style source, exact accepted four-property marker clear, shorthand fallback at start/mid/end, viewport lengths/viewBox, orient parsing, largest singular scale, signed-remainder mid angle and authored segment placements.

algorithms.name: mask region and expansion planning
algorithms.proof: maskUnits/maskContentUnits, bbox/user-space percentage references, default/custom regions, luminance/alpha and source-only direct child expansions with active recursion guard.

algorithms.name: pattern tile and content mapping
algorithms.proof: Units, viewport lengths, bbox fractions, tile origin/size limits, patternTransform inverse and scale, preserveAspectRatio viewBox mapping, pixel-axis/area caps, exact legacy cache key.

algorithms.name: source references and bounds
algorithms.proof: Canonical shared ReferenceIndex local ID lookup, expected unprefixed definition kinds, checked source spans, actual owner ShapeId/bounds/affines.

algorithms.name: controlled marker placement scans
algorithms.proof: Public marker placement APIs require caller WorkControl; each path segment (including zero-edge commands) is charged before processing, and primitive pair iteration charges Expansion. Overflowing preserveAspectRatio offset+length returns InvalidArgument at the authored offset.

algorithms.name: controlled filter reference lookup
algorithms.proof: Public parse_filter requires WorkControl; both its initial DefinitionSource token-span validation and subsequent token/candidate-attribute ID scans charge TokenVisit and map limit/cancel stops to accepted diagnostics.

algorithms.name: transactional group mutation failure path
algorithms.proof: apply_group performs incremental accepted DraftToken finalizations; the focused caller fixture proves a late third-checkpoint cancellation after the first mutation, then rollback_draft restores logical shape/clip tables and source shape data. SceneBuilder retains Vec capacity after rollback.

algorithms.name: seeded paint/clip fixture generation
algorithms.proof: Rust test support ports every branch and emitted content of tests/svg/shape/paint_clip_generator.py::random_paint_clip_document using explicit SplitMix64 seed 0x5041494e545f434c; 12 fixture outputs cover all index-driven gradient/units/fraction combinations and validate stable generation.

algorithms.name: controlled primitive marker pair scan
algorithms.proof: Public primitive marker placement requires WorkControl and charges Expansion before every adjacent-edge pair; a two-pair work-limit fixture proves the stop and exact accepted cost.

algorithms.name: accepted typed production definition adapter
algorithms.proof: Implements the shared DefinitionPlanner contract; validates DefinitionOwner source/draft/element; Shape routes plan clip/mask/pattern/marker and Group routes actual source-derived filter without a dummy shape; complete PatternMapping crosses the mapped ticket publication API.

algorithms.name: job-ledger plan admission and failure cleanup
algorithms.proof: Fixed-capacity per-plan AllocationJournal meters actual retained expansions/filter primitives and bounded ancestor/filter/viewBox scratch Vec capacities under the same ChargeLedger; plan or mapping failure releases admitted leases and restores planner limits; capacity-failure/retry proof covers late admission failure.

later_composition: Actual combined ChannelAwareProductionDecodeOperations dispatch, complete definition traversal, KernelResources/FlatKernel/native providers, authentic pattern content rendering, full original renderer oracles, and integrated application/runtime/release/MCP demonstrations remain later integration gates. The accepted Scene156 channel planner surface is implemented here; no fake backend or empty-success provider is supplied.
